issues.description: Ingest upserts new records but never deletes stale results or aliases, so removed/skipped input rows remain in reports.
Format B assumes metrics is a dict; non-empty list/string/int metrics crashes with AttributeError instead of producing a warning.
Malformed XML raises ParseError and aborts ingest rather than recording a malformed_row warning.
NaN scores are accepted as floats and bypass clamping, causing SQLite insertion failure or invalid canonical scores.
Parsers accept empty run_id/model/task values and stringify null JSON IDs, creating ambiguous rows and collision-prone keys.
The results schema does not enforce score range/finite values or non-empty identifiers, so canonical invariants rely entirely on parser behavior.
Untrusted XML is parsed with xml.etree without defensive limits, leaving a crash/DoS surface for hostile XML inputs.
CSV and JSONL inputs are read fully into memory, which can exhaust memory on large evaluation exports.
Format A parses CSV line-by-line, so valid CSV records containing quoted newlines are misparsed.
Format A over-split recovery falls back to raw comma splitting, which corrupts otherwise valid quoted CSV if earlier columns contain commas.
Ingesting an empty directory creates an empty SQLite database before returning a no-input-files error.
Package metadata is minimal and omits README/license/authors and test extras, making distribution and maintenance rougher.
